home.mission: I help women and young people navigate the moments where they have lost themselves, using homeopathy, science, and honest conversation.
home.introBody: Before I became a homeopath I was a research scientist. I hold a PhD in Natural Sciences and I co-authored a biology textbook that has been on the compulsory reading list for undergraduate science courses in Croatia for over a decade. I came to homeopathy after a difficult post-partum period, when it helped me personally. I have been in private practice in London since 2009.
home.introBody2: That training has stayed with me. I listen closely, I take careful notes, I look for patterns, and I am honest with you about what I can and cannot say.

about.seoTitle: About Nataša Perić | Homeopath in London since 2009
about.seoDescription: Nataša Perić, PhD in Natural Sciences, homeopath in private practice in London since 2009 and supervisor at the Centre for Homeopathic Education.
about.title: About Natasa
about.standfirst: I am a homeopath in private practice in London. Before that I was a research scientist. Both of those things shape how I work.

sections.heading: How I came to this work
sections.body: I trained and worked as a research scientist and I did not expect to end up here. I came to homeopathy after a difficult post-partum period, when it helped me personally, at a point when I was not looking for it. I wanted to understand why. That question turned into a training, and then into a practice, and I have been seeing clients in London since 2009.

sections.heading: Where the science shows up
sections.body: My PhD is in Natural Sciences and I co-authored a biology textbook that has been on the compulsory reading list for undergraduate science courses in Croatia for over a decade. What I carry from that is method. I listen closely, I record carefully, I look for the pattern that connects things rather than the loudest single symptom, and I am careful with language. If something is uncertain, I will say so.

sections.heading: How I work with you
sections.body: I work with you and for you. This is a partnership between us, built on mutual trust and respect, on honesty and openness. Your treatment is tailored to you as an individual, and it moves at the pace your health actually moves at. I am not the authority in the room. You know things about your own body that I need you to tell me.

sections.heading: Who I work best with
sections.body: The people I work best with are people who work on themselves. Many have done some form of therapy, they are committed to their wellbeing, and they are tuned in. That matters for a practical reason rather than a lofty one. I ask probing questions, such as why you feel shame and where it lives in you, and people who already know themselves a little can answer them. That is where the real material is. What I am doing in a consultation is trying to understand your emotional landscape, as much as a human being as a homeopath. This way of working is not for everyone. If you would like a quick fix, or you have tried everything and are not committed to anything, you will probably not get much from it, and I would rather say so than take your money.

sections.heading: Teaching and supervision
sections.body: I teach and supervise at the Centre for Homeopathic Education in London, where I lead the Research Proposition module. Supervision keeps me in contact with how the next generation of practitioners is being trained, and it keeps my own thinking honest.

credentials: LCHE, Licentiate of the Centre for Homeopathic Education
In private practice in London since 2009
Lecturer and supervisor, Centre for Homeopathic Education, London
Registered with the Complementary Therapist Association
about.closingBody: The first consultation is long and unhurried. It is the best way to find out whether this way of working suits you.

homeopathy.seoTitle: What homeopathy is | Homeopathy with Natasa, London
homeopathy.seoDescription: Homeopathy treats the body as one integrated system rather than isolated organs. What a consultation is like, what it may support, and how remedies are sent.
homeopathy.title: Homeopathy
homeopathy.standfirst: A type of medicine that treats the body as one unique integrated system, in order to identify the root cause of symptoms.
homeopathy.whatBody: Conventional medicine has become very good at studying organs separately. The heart, the gut, the skin, the hormones: each one is studied on its own and treated by a different specialty. That division is useful, and it is also why a person with several connected symptoms can end up with several separate explanations and no single one.
homeopathy.whatBody2: Homeopathy starts from the other end. It treats the body as one unique integrated system, and it reads symptoms as expressions of that whole system rather than as separate faults. The aim is to identify the root cause rather than to quieten each symptom in turn. The remedy is chosen for you as an individual, and the body is gently stimulated to heal itself.
notItems: It is not a replacement for your doctor. Please keep your medical care, and please tell me about it.
It is not mystical. I am a former research scientist and I speak plainly about what is known and what is not.
It is not fast. Longstanding patterns rarely shift quickly, and I will not pretend otherwise.
It is not passive. You are an active part of this, and what you notice between sessions matters.
homeopathy.promiseTitle: What I can and cannot promise
homeopathy.promiseBody: I do not give promises. I give you my full expertise and knowledge, and what happens next also depends on you: what you do with it, your own vital force, your lifestyle, and everything else that affects healing. What I offer instead of a promise is an educational dialogue. I explain how homeopathy works, and I give you an honest indication of what is realistic, given what you are living with and how long it has been there.
homeopathy.supportTitle: What people come to me with
homeopathy.supportIntro: People come to me at many different points. Most often they are living with something that has continued for a long time and has been looked at in pieces. Homeopathy may support the person as a whole while that is going on. I do not make claims about outcomes for named conditions.
supportItems: Hormonal changes across different stages of life
Low energy and exhaustion that has no clear explanation
Recurrent complaints that keep returning in the same pattern
Sleep, tension and states of mind that sit alongside physical symptoms
Wanting support during a demanding period rather than treatment for one thing

consultationSteps.heading: Before we meet
consultationSteps.body: You book a time and I send you a short form. Nothing complicated. It helps me arrive prepared.

consultationSteps.heading: The first consultation
consultationSteps.body: We talk for around ninety minutes, by video. I will ask about your health history, but also about sleep, appetite, temperature, energy, mood, what makes things better and what makes them worse. Some questions will feel unrelated. They are how the pattern becomes visible.

consultationSteps.heading: After we talk
consultationSteps.body: I take time to study your case properly before choosing anything. This is the part of the work you do not see, and it is where the research training earns its place.

consultationSteps.heading: Your remedy
consultationSteps.body: I select a remedy for you as an individual, post it to you, and explain how and when to take it, in writing, so you are not relying on memory.

consultationSteps.heading: Follow-up
consultationSteps.body: We usually meet again after four to six weeks. We look at what has changed, including small things, and adjust. Small changes make a big difference.

homeopathy.remediesBody: Consultations are currently held online by video, and your remedies are posted to you. They are prepared by an established homeopathic pharmacy and sent to your address in the UK, usually arriving within a few days. If you are outside the UK we will agree the arrangement together before your consultation. Homeopathic medicines are included in the consultation fee, except for acute consultations and detox therapies. Postage is charged separately.
homeopathy.remediesBody2: You will always receive written instructions. If anything is unclear afterwards, write to me. I would rather answer a short question than have you guessing.
homeopathy.askBody: Honesty and openness, including about the things that feel small or awkward. Patience, because this is gradual. And that you stay in touch between sessions if something changes. In return you have my full attention, my time, and a straight answer whenever I have one.

mentoring.seoTitle: Supervision and mentoring for homeopaths | Nataša Perić
mentoring.seoDescription: One-to-one and small group supervision for homeopathy students and newly qualified practitioners, with a lecturer at the Centre for Homeopathic Education.
mentoring.title: Mentoring and supervision
mentoring.standfirst: You have a case in front of you and nobody to think it through with. This is where we do that together.
forItems: Students in clinical training who want to talk a case through properly
Newly qualified practitioners setting up their first practice
Anyone working on a research proposition or written case work
mentoring.oneToOneBody: A session for your cases and your questions. We look at what you gathered, what you may have missed, and how you reached your decision. The aim is not to hand you an answer. It is to make your own reasoning clearer and more repeatable.
mentoring.groupBody: Small groups, so that everyone speaks. One or two cases per session, presented by members of the group, discussed openly. Practitioners often learn as much from a case that is not theirs.

howSteps.heading: You send the case in advance
howSteps.body: So that I arrive having read it, and our time goes on the thinking rather than the summary.

howSteps.heading: We work through it together
howSteps.body: Case taking, analysis, remedy reasoning, and what you would do differently next time.

howSteps.heading: You leave with notes
howSteps.body: A short written summary of what we agreed, for your records and your training log.

mentoring.backgroundBody: I teach and supervise at the Centre for Homeopathic Education in London, where I lead the Research Proposition module. I have been in practice since 2009 and I came to homeopathy from research science, so I am comfortable with methodology, with evidence, and with saying plainly when something is not known.
mentoring.pricingNote: Small groups are two or three people, so that everyone gets to speak. Sessions usually run for an hour and a half, sometimes two. One-to-one sessions are charged by the hour, and a shorter follow-up is charged accordingly.

priceRows.label: Small group supervision, 90 minutes, per person

mentoring.closingBody: Tell me where you are in your training and what you would like support with, and we will find a format that fits.
mentoring.recognitionTitle: You may recognise some of this
recognitionItems: You are sitting with a case and you are not sure whether your reasoning holds, and there is nobody to check it against.
You need supervision hours to qualify, and you would like them to be genuinely useful rather than a box to tick.
You have finished your training and suddenly you are on your own, with real people in front of you.
You know the theory, and still you freeze when a live case looks like nothing in the books.
You are writing up a case or a research proposition and you do not know whether it is good enough.

privacy.seoDescription: How Nataša Perić collects, uses and protects your personal information.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.heading: Who I am
sections.body: I am Nataša Perić, a homeopath in private practice, working online by video and in person in Telegraph Hill, south east London, by arrangement. I decide how the information described here is used. My email address is in the footer of every page, and it is the best way to reach me about anything on this page.

sections.heading: What I collect
sections.body: Your name, email address and anything you choose to tell me when you write to me, use the contact form or book an appointment. If you become a client, I also hold the health information you share with me during consultations, together with my case notes, the remedies selected and the postal address remedies are sent to.

sections.heading: Why I hold it
sections.body: To reply to you, to arrange appointments, to provide your care, to send your remedies, and to keep the case records a practitioner is expected to keep. Where the information concerns your health, I hold it on the basis that it is necessary for providing health care to you, and because you have chosen to share it with me for that purpose.

sections.heading: How long I keep it
sections.body: Consultation records are held for the period a practitioner is required to keep them. TODO: confirm the exact retention period before the site goes live. Enquiries that do not lead to an appointment are deleted once they are no longer needed.

sections.heading: Who else sees it
sections.body: An established homeopathic pharmacy prepares and posts your remedies, and receives only the information needed to do that, such as your name, address and the remedy. My email provider handles the messages we exchange. Nothing is sold, and nothing is shared for marketing.

sections.heading: This website
sections.body: This site stores two things in your own browser: your language preference and your cookie choice. There is no analytics and no tracking. What you send through the contact form goes to me and is recorded in my secure client management system so that I can reply. It is not published anywhere.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask to see the information I hold about you, to have it corrected, or to have it deleted where I am not required to keep it. Write to me and I will respond within one month. If you are not satisfied with how I have handled something, you may complain to the Information Commissioner's Office.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.standfirst: The terms on which consultations are provided.

sections.heading: Consultations
sections.body: Consultations are provided by Nataša Perić, homeopath, currently online by video, with in person appointments in Telegraph Hill, south east London, available by arrangement. Homeopathy is a complementary therapy. Booking an appointment means you accept these terms.

sections.heading: Fees and payment
sections.body: Current fees are listed on the Consultations and Pricing page. Payment is due at the time of the appointment unless we have agreed otherwise. Homeopathic medicines are included in the consultation fees, except for acute consultations and detox therapies. Postage is charged separately, from £3.50, depending on size and weight.

sections.heading: Cancellations
sections.body: Please give at least 24 hours' notice if you need to cancel or reschedule, or 48 hours if you have not seen me before. Late cancellations and missed appointments are charged in full. If something urgent happens, tell me. I would rather know.

sections.heading: Remedies
sections.body: Remedies are prepared by an established homeopathic pharmacy and posted to the address you give me, usually arriving within a few days. Written instructions are always included. If you are outside the UK we will agree the arrangement before your consultation.

sections.heading: Medical care
sections.body: Homeopathy does not replace medical advice or treatment. I do not diagnose, and I will never advise you to stop medication prescribed by your doctor. Please continue with your medical care and tell me about any medication you take. If something needs medical attention, I will say so.

sections.heading: Use of this website
sections.body: The content of this site is for general information and is not personal health advice. Links to other sites are provided for convenience and I am not responsible for their content. I may update these terms, and the version published here is the one that applies.

ethics.seoTitle: Code of Ethics | Homeopathy with Natasa
ethics.seoDescription: The professional standards Nataša Perić practises to, as a member of the Complementary Therapist Association.
ethics.title: Code of Ethics
ethics.standfirst: The standards I hold myself to.

sections.heading: Professional registration
sections.body: I am registered with the Complementary Therapist Association and I practise in line with its code of conduct. I hold professional insurance and I keep my registration current.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.body: What you tell me stays between us. Case notes are kept securely, and your details are shared only where they are needed to send your remedy, or where the law requires me to share them. If I ever want to use an anonymised case for teaching or supervision, I will ask you first.

sections.heading: Consent
sections.body: You decide what happens. I explain what I am suggesting and why, in plain language, so you can make your own choice, and you may pause or stop at any point without needing to justify it.

sections.heading: Scope of practice
sections.body: I work as a homeopath and not as a doctor. I do not diagnose, and I never advise you to stop or change medication prescribed for you. I do not make claims about outcomes for named conditions, and I will not offer treatment that is outside what I am trained to do.

sections.heading: Honesty and uncertainty
sections.body: I do not give promises. I tell you what is realistic, and I tell you when something is uncertain or unknown. If this way of working does not seem right for you, I would rather say so early.

sections.heading: Referral
sections.body: If something you describe needs medical attention, or another practitioner would serve you better, I will say so and encourage you to go. Your safety comes before continuing with me.

sections.heading: Continuing development
sections.body: I keep learning. I teach and supervise at the Centre for Homeopathic Education in London, I take supervision myself, and I complete continuing professional development every year.
